visual_summary: At the top of a massive industrial structure, two dark-haired women in black restrain a woman in a flowing white dress while accusing her of sorcery and theft. Below, a white-haired man rides upward in a transparent elevator tube, complains that it is too slow, rushes into a weapons room, grabs a large firearm, and sprints back out with a fierce expression.
